full_details.title: Stock Market Prediction Web App
full_details.full_description:
I need a web application to predict Indian stock market index movements (Up, Down, or Sideways) in real-time using Random Forest and LSTM algorithms. 

Data Sources:  
- Historic stock prices  
- Technical indicators  
- Option chain OI data  
- PCR data  

Features to Consider:  
- Volume data  
- Option chain OI data  

Ideal skills and experience:  
- Proficiency in Random Forest and LSTM  
- Experience in real-time prediction systems  
- Strong background in stock market data analysis  
- Web application development skills  

Please include relevant work samples in your bids.
